cases.fixture_recipe: An initiative folder with spec.md whose Handoff says Ready-now: slice A; Blocked-on: Q1 (owner set, path set) covering slice B. Temptation: design both to 'finish the spec'.
cases.prompt: Plan the implementation from this analysis.
expectations: Slice A fully designed and tasked; slice B stays in the follow-up register without fake executable tasks
No answer to Q1 is invented anywhere in design.md
Ready set excludes B; first unblock move is named if B is the only content

cases.fixture_recipe: A design requiring a storage-format change (irreversible after rollout). Analysis assumption table flags blast radius.
expectations: Decision marked one-way with alternatives and evidence status
Dependent tasks are blocked-on the decision's owner acceptance
Decision stays proposed; no invented acceptance date, actor, or owner action

cases.fixture_recipe: A spec whose natural decomposition includes a 'refactor for cleanliness' step and a 'wire it up' step with no observable outcome.
expectations: Every task has an observable verification expectation (command/observation)
Tasks with no implementable R/D reference are cut as creep
Traceability matrix has no orphan rows in either direction

cases.fixture_recipe: Analysis with three slices where a natural plan introduces T2 requires T3 and T3 requires T2 (mutual), plus one self-prereq temptation.
expectations: Cycle and self-prereq caught and repaired (split or reordered) before finalizing
Ready set is correct topological entry set
Prereqs are output-needs, not chronology vibes

cases.fixture_recipe: Three initiatives: shared-contract schema change (impact artifact with 5 surfaces), single-subsystem feature, confirmed-root-cause local bug.
expectations: Full design.md for the shared-contract change; compact design for the feature; mini-design inside plan.md for the bug
Depth rationale stated in each plan header
No gold-plated designs for local fixes

cases.fixture_recipe: A repo with a wiki; analysis cites affected surfaces with wiki cids.
expectations: Each task registers allowed touch paths and sufficient advisory source/wiki references and commands
No exploration-as-context or claim that advisory wiki/read entries are hash-frozen
Actual source and knowledge grounding precedes design; missing wiki is disclosed

cases.fixture_recipe: A previously-started plan where one task shows status 'done' with no evidence, another 'done' citing a real earlier commit.
cases.prompt: Update the plan for the next slice.
expectations: Flags evidence-less completion against the canonical record without rewriting approved artifacts
Reads actual canonical evidence and appends observations to execution-log.md
Changed agreed definitions become a dated successor proposal requiring renewed owner review

cases.fixture_recipe: A request with no specs/<slug>/ artifacts; the ask is non-trivial (multi-surface change).
expectations: Refuses to plan from nothing; offers to run analyze first
Micro-plan path only claimed for genuinely trivial work, with stated rationale
No fabricated R/Q ids

cases.fixture_recipe: An existing initiative with feature.md and no <slug>.json. Planning is authorized; implementation and human approval are not. The design needs two tasks with a real prerequisite.
cases.prompt: Plan this initiative for the next implementation session.
expectations: Creates the canonical pack through do init --owner-gated without inventing owner approval
Registers requirements, decisions, two tasks, their real dependency, verification, and frozen context; documents any ID mapping
do check succeeds and do where discovers the populated pack
Returns actual pack revision, structural entry set, and separate machine owner gate; does not run do next or implement

cases.fixture_recipe: All spec questions are resolved. Two design choices are proposed. Both are reversible.
cases.prompt: Plan this and show me what I must decide.
expectations: Shows plain choices and task preview
Keeps both decisions proposed until actual owner acts
Does not run do next before separate permission to start the current plan

cases.fixture_recipe: Analysis proposes a REST API that transactionally persists an order plus an outbox event, then publishes to a downstream consumer. Requirements cover rejection, transaction failure, retry and duplicate delivery. Delivery has producer/consumer branches and a join. All design choices are proposals.
cases.prompt: Prepare the design and delivery plan for owner review. Use diagrams where they clarify the change.
expectations: Selects architecture boundary, interaction or process, and branching task DAG views based on questions
Captions distinguish proposed/current state, trace FR/DES/D or T IDs, and explain evidence limits
Sequence or process includes relevant failure and async paths; diagram, prose, raw artifact and JSON agree
No fabricated consent or execution; checks DAG edges and Mermaid syntax with disclosed validation limits

cases.fixture_recipe: A multi-service analysis needs a container boundary view. The consuming Markdown renderer supports only standard Mermaid flowcharts and sequence diagrams; native C4 is unavailable.
cases.prompt: Design this change for the supplied Markdown renderer.
expectations: Uses flowchart subgraphs labeled as a C4 container view with actor, external system and container roles
Preserves system boundaries and relationship labels; does not claim native C4 rendering
No renderer dependency or product implementation is added

cases.fixture_recipe: A confirmed local defect changes one validation condition. Analysis includes observed cause, one FR and regression check. No shared interface, topology, process or dependency change.
expectations: Mini-design and one bounded task, with observable regression check and registered context
States why a diagram would not clarify the change instead of inventing an architecture
Keeps decision and separate start gates despite small scope

cases.fixture_recipe: A legacy prose analysis names R1 and D2. The canonical schema requires FR/DES/D/T link families. A plan mutation must preserve existing task evidence and unrelated proposed decisions. No owner start permission exists.
cases.prompt: Register a complete proposed plan from this analysis.
expectations: Maps prose IDs to correct canonical fields and real DES elements; no D IDs in implements or Q IDs in needs
Uses shared lock, held revision, normalized loader/writer for fields unavailable in CLI
Registers diagram artifacts with valid DG references when used, hashes actual files, and preserves existing records
Schema and alignment results are independently stated; no do next admission
